admissible_source_evidence.variant_a: Retention note for the frost log. The frost log kept by the night keeper records each evening's reading from the garden post, and the reading is taken at the hour the lamps are lit. This note fixes the log's treatment: the frost log is a durable record of the house. At the close of the season the night keeper hands the book to the records clerk, who shelves it in the long archive, and any reading from it may be recalled into a later record of the house whenever a comparison is wanted. A fresh book is opened each season, and this note is read out when the fresh book is opened.
admissible_source_evidence.variant_b: Retention note for the frost log. The frost log kept by the night keeper records each evening's reading from the garden post, and the reading is taken at the hour the lamps are lit. This note fixes the log's treatment: the frost log is a seasonal working record. At the close of the season the night keeper hands the book to the records clerk, who copies nothing forward and destroys the book within the week, and no reading from it is recalled into any later record of the house. A fresh book is opened each season, and this note is read out when the fresh book is opened.
